evals.prompt: Проверь, стоит ли обновлять Paseo: что вышло после моей версии и что из моей обвязки сломается.
evals.expected_output: A compact brief with installed and latest versions, per-plugin/skill/hook impact, and exactly one verdict.
assertions: Runs scripts/paseo-maintenance (status, update-check, plugins at minimum) instead of ad-hoc inspection.
Reads release notes for every release between installed and latest, not only the latest one, and checks SDK changes with scripts/paseo-maintenance changes.
Names any enabled plugin whose requirements.paseo excludes the target version, including caret ranges such as ^0.9.0 that cap the minor, not only explicit < bounds.
Ends with exactly one of the four fixed verdict strings.
Does not install @getpaseo/cli, unpack app.asar, or restart the daemon.

Reports the three tracks separately (vendored skills, wf commands, own skills) and asks the user whether to run each own skill eval (e.g. paseo-move-chat eval_run.py) before calling own skills verified.

evals.prompt: Paseo обновился, мой плагин в worktree перестал показываться. Разберись.
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis from plugin status and paseo-maintenance logs (paseo plugin logs first, main.log second), a fix in the plugin's working copy, reload, and a request for visual confirmation.
assertions: Checks plugin status and the load error from paseo-maintenance logs (paseo plugin logs), not only main.log, before editing code.
Fixes the plugin in place and does not relocate it or rewrite its configured path.
Validates with typecheck/tests and paseo plugin reload plus a log check, not typecheck alone.
Asks the user to confirm the UI visually before calling it done.

evals.prompt: Синхронизируй вендорные paseo-скилы и wf-команды с текущей версией Paseo.
evals.expected_output: vendor-skills and vendor-commands results, skill bodies updated from the upstream tag with local frontmatter kept, wf commands re-read against changed upstream sections, and the rulesync deploy step.
assertions: Uses the upstream tag matching the running daemon version.
Runs vendor-skills and vendor-commands as separate tracks.
Preserves local rulesync frontmatter (targets) when copying upstream skill bodies.
Treats wf commands as adaptations: updates meaning from changed sections and keeps $ARGUMENTS, instead of copying sections verbatim.
Re-runs both commands and reports them clean, or explains what remains.
Mentions make install-agents-global-configs to deploy the change.

evals.prompt: Paseo само обновилось до новой версии. Проверь, что у меня ничего не отвалилось, и что с ближайшей бетой.
evals.expected_output: Analysis of the already-applied jump (previous -> installed), plugin load failures with their cause, managed-plugin update availability, a Ремонт сейчас section, and a verdict about the next (beta) release.
assertions: Uses update-check applied= releases (previous version from the auto-updater log or --from) instead of stopping at installed == latest.
Runs update-check --pre and plugins with the beta version as a target.
Reports plugins that already fail to load with the cause from paseo-maintenance logs (paseo plugin logs), not only main.log.
Checks managed-plugin updates through the plugins update lines (whether the candidate release admits the daemon and target versions) and does not apply them without consent.
Puts breakage from the installed version under Ремонт сейчас and gives exactly one verdict about the next release.
Asks whether to run the paseo-move-chat eval stand on the installed version; without consent reports it as not verified, never as fine.
